Royal Office of Practical Matters

Support, plainly stated.

Commercial matters are administered in direct language. Product status, payment, fulfillment, and customer rights shall remain unambiguous.

Before launch

The current storefront contains development issues and one restricted test checkout configuration. General sales and public customer support have not yet opened.

Order status

Customers with a valid order token will be able to view payment, production, shipment, and delivery status through the existing order-status service.

Final policies

Shipping, return, replacement, sizing, care, and contact information will be published before products become publicly purchasable.
